item.title: ufbr — via awesome-svelte
item.description: An Universal File Based Router with Svelte support.

item.title: microfolio — via awesome-svelte
item.description: A static portfolio generator for creatives built with SvelteKit and Tailwind CSS 4, where content is just folders and Markdown files instead of a database, with interactive maps, EXIF metadata extraction and no tracking.

item.title: human-kit — via awesome-svelte
item.description: Headless, accessible UI primitives for Svelte 5 - ARIA semantics, keyboard interaction and focus management included, styling left entirely to you.

item.title: crd-ui — via awesome-svelte
item.description: Credit and debit card visualization for payment forms and saved-card views, with live brand detection and a 3D flip.

item.title: Product Plate — via awesome-svelte
item.description: An open-source SvelteKit + Convex starter for building SaaS products.

item.title: PR Cockpit — via awesome-svelte
item.description: An extremely fast GitHub for reviewing pull requests: PRs open in about 20 ms. Keyboard-first, with a CLI for coding agents. Svelte 5 runes UI over a Bun server.

item.title: My SvelteKit Starter — via awesome-svelte
item.description: A production-ready SvelteKit boilerplate optimized for AI-assisted development, featuring Svelte 5 runes, Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn-svelte style components, i18n, and pre-configured agent instructions.

item.title: File Viewer — via awesome-svelte
item.description: An offline-first Svelte component that previews 206 file extensions with lazy renderer presets and no server-side conversion.

item.title: Capgo — via awesome-svelte
item.description: Live updates / OTA for Capacitor apps.
